children: How much does AI app development cost?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-74bd046 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A simple AI proof of concept starts from $15K. A full-scale web or mobile AI application typically ranges from $60K to $300K, depending on complexity, AI capabilities, and infrastructure requirements. The precise number is defined in the Discovery Sprint.
How long does it take to build an AI app?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-2917d6e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A focused AI MVP takes 8 to 12 weeks. A full-scale AI application takes 3 to 9 months, depending on scope, data readiness, and integration complexity.
What factors influence AI app development cost?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-df71506 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: The main cost drivers are the number of AI features, data availability, model complexity, backend infrastructure, third-party integrations, compliance needs, and whether AI is being built from scratch or integrated into an existing product.
Can AI features be added to an existing app?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-dbc0ba6 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Chatbots, recommendation engines, predictive analytics, NLP pipelines, and computer vision can all be integrated into existing applications without rebuilding them.
What is the difference between an AI app and a regular app?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-31f046d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A regular app adds AI after the core product is built. An AI app is designed around what the intelligence needs to do from the start. The data model, backend architecture, and integration layer are all built around the AI requirements.
Can AI apps be built for both iOS and Android?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-d951992 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. We build cross-platform applications using Flutter and React Native, as well as native iOS and Android apps using Swift and Kotlin. The right approach depends on your performance requirements and budget.
Do AI apps require custom data?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-574c00f e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Some AI apps need business-specific datasets to perform precisely. Others can leverage pre-trained models or public datasets depending on the use case. Data readiness is evaluated in Discovery before model selection begins.
Can we start with an AI app MVP?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-0a4c208 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. An AI MVP validates the core concept and identifies the highest-value features before full investment. Typically scoped and delivered in 8 to 12 weeks.
